selection.reason: The live peer-discovery owner advertises every ACP tool and complete service methods, including generic execution and mirror operations; this is an actionable security boundary independent of source-authority-gated structural promotion.

evidence.before: Discovery exposed all registry tools and complete methods for each tool-backed service.
evidence.after: Default-deny allowlist exposes identity:recover and retrieval Search/RRFFuse/Rerank only; the route filters registry tool records by descriptor tool IDs.
evidence.testCoverage: The discovery tool-list helper used by the route is fixture-tested against write/mirror and unknown tool entries.
evidence.authorizationBoundary: Metadata filtering only; admin route remains protected and actual RPC handlers still require their own authorization.

openSpecProgress.delta: A2A-03 completed as a peer-discovery metadata boundary; no A2A execution, canonical storage, or write authority was added.
